cases.fault: attempt to alter/delete closed affiliation history
cases.expected: SQLite transition/delete guards reject

cases.expected: IDEMPOTENCY_CONFLICT; no new mutation

cases.fault: malicious reference_type/cursor/sort value attempts SQL/path injection
cases.expected: closed enum/cursor decoder rejects before repository; SQL identifiers remain static and values bound

cases.fault: candidate/blocker/page exceeds visible page limit
cases.expected: bounded page + exact state/count/continuation; omitted rows never change AMBIGUOUS or eligibility

cases.fault: repository SQL/constraint exception occurs after receipt insertion before commit
cases.expected: UnitOfWork rollback removes receipt and every partial row; stable error crosses boundary, raw SQLite exception does not

coverage_rule: Every LLD-02 mutation family has rollback/stale/invariant-bypass coverage; every read-heavy family has boundedness/injection coverage; double-review acceptance requires no known unbounded write-lock path.
